description: This file defines the EmployeeDependentAPI class which provides REST API endpoints for managing employee dependents in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting employee dependent records, along with validation rules and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentAPI
classes.description: API class for managing employee dependents, including retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting dependents, with validation and Swagger annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Fetch a specific employee dependent by employee number and dependent ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: List all dependents for a specific employee, with optional filters and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Create a new employee dependent record.

methods.name: saveEmpDependent
methods.description: Helper method to instantiate or update an EmpDependent entity from request data.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Returns validation rules common to create and update methods.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rules for getOne method parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validation rules for getAll method parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Update an existing employee dependent record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for update method parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Remove dependents for an employee, given a list of IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for delete method parameters.
